title: Mar bar Rav Ada
author: Aharon Hyman

paragraphs: In [Shabbat 140a](https://www.sefaria.org/Shabbat.140a.17-18), Rav Acha bar Yosef was suffering from heaviness of the heart and consulted Mar Ukva. He later asked in the study hall, where they cited a teaching of the school of Rav Ada, or, alternatively, Mar bar Rav Ada’s school. Hyman considers the reading he cites from Yuchasin, “bar Rav Ada bar Ahava,” very sound: Rav Chiyya bar Avin says there, “I asked Rav Ada bar Ahava.” The unqualified Rav Ada did not live in their generation; Rav Ada bar Ahava did.[^1]

notes.text: The linked text gives the school of Rav Ada and, as an alternative, the school of Mar bar Rav Ada. Rav Chiyya bar Avin tells of asking Rav Ada bar Ahava about soaking the remedy. [Heilprin](https://www.girsology.com/seder-hadorot.html?entry=2417&lang=en) lists Mar bar Rav Ada bar Ahava as a headword. Hyman uses the chronology to favor the fuller name.
